# Aesthetic & ARG tooling

Retro/terminal/CRT UI, open fonts and fictional paperwork, found-footage and signal effects, ciphers and steganography, and storytelling UIs.

Stars checked 2026-09-23. Notes: [notes/aesthetic.md](../notes/aesthetic.md). Sync locally: `node scripts/sync.mjs --category aesthetic`
